author: Gregory Conner
text: I called to have my septic pumped. Drew was great. He got me in quickly and did a great job. I would highly recommend using this service.

author: Patty Blicharz
text: Drew is the best!! Had a bit of an emergency, answered and came out right away to help us! THANK YOU!!

author: J W
text: Our toilets stopped flushing and started bubbling and Elk River was incredibly fast to respond and come out to help us!! We called a closer company in town and they never called us back (this happened 7 days ago and they still haven't called back). SO happy that we contacted Elk River!! Incredibly nice service and was able to fix our issues. Will be using them from now on. Thank you!!

author: John & Lori Britz
text: Elk river does an excellent job. They call you back and let you know when they will be there..  Jack

author: E W
text: I had a septic tank emergency and Elk River were the only ones that called me back. Not only did he call me back, he same out within 30 minutes of calling and stayed onsite until the septic was pumped and he helped troubleshoot and resolve a large problem. You saved us, thank you!!!
